subject: Pilot recap — unit spend runway & batch/cache levers
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@trailpay.com>, Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@trailpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot recap — unit spend runway & batch/cache levers

Hi Samir / Lisa,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the candid budget context. Quick recap from our side and next steps so we stay aligned: 

Key pain & goals we heard
- High per-transaction latency and rising token spend on nightly reconciliation and chat flows.
- Need a pilot that proves 30–50% per-token spend improvement while keeping p99 latency under 300ms for critical flows.
- Procurement needs a conservative TCO case scoped to Q3 budget gates.

What Redwood recommended on the call (short version)
- Pilot scope: 3-week technical validation, then 6-week scale run using a single high-volume route (reconciliation).
- Cost levers: batching (micro-batch for async reconciliation), prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts, and a conservative quantization profile for non-chat models.
- Baseline assumptions included in the attached estimate: monthly active tokens ~120M, current bill projection, and three cost scenarios (conservative / likely / optimistic).

Estimated uplift / ROI (high level)
- Conservative case: 18–22% unit cost reduction via batching + cache for reconciliation workloads.
- Likely case: 30–40% with tuned batching parameters and KV prefix hits ~40%.
- Upside: additional savings if we can move non-latency-sensitive paths to a 4-bit quantized variant (optional).

Attachments
- pilot_estimates_v1.xlsx (breakdown: token counts, per-token price bands, batching hit rate sensitivity)

Concrete next steps
1) Samir/Lisa to confirm Q3 budget ceiling for pilot and any procurement windows (end of May vs. mid-June).
2) Redwood to provide a conservative ROI appendix and a one-pager SOW draft (by EOD Wed).
3) Schedule 30m ops call w/ engineering to align telemetry & log access (please propose times for next Tue/Wed).

If anything above looks off, flag and I’ll update. Otherwise I’ll loop Marissa in to push the conservative cost appendix and SOW.

Best,
Tessa Morgan | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: pilot_estimates_v1.xlsx)
From: Samir Patel <samir@trailpay.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@trailpay.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot recap — unit spend runway & batch/cache levers

Tessa — thanks for the concise recap. Couple clarifications from our side: 

- Q3 pilot budget: our finance owner gave a hard cap of $35,000/month for proof-of-value. Any plan that exceeds that will need an executive exception and slow things down.
- Latency: the reconciliation path can tolerate up to 400ms p99 during the pilot window, but chat flows must stay below 300ms — we'll separate the routes in the pilot.

On the conservative ROI appendix, the finance team wants a scenario that assumes only 20% batching hit and 15% caching hit to be safe. Can you provide that variant?

Also can you include a simple list of telemetry we need to expose (tokens by route, p99/p50, cache hit-rate) — I'll make sure engineering will unblock access.

Lisa and I can do a 30m ops call next Tue (18th) at 10:00am PT or Wed at 11:00am PT. Which works for you?

-Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Engineering
TrailPay Inc.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@trailpay.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@trailpay.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot recap — unit spend runway & batch/cache levers

Samir — great call. Adding the conservative variant and a slightly tighter SOW outline here. High-level notes: 

1) Conservative ROI variant attached (see 20270511_unit_spend_model.csv) — this uses your requested 20% batching / 15% cache hit assumptions and an entry per-token price reflective of our dedicated small-pool band.
2) Pilot packaging that fits $35k/mo cap:
   - Phase 1 (2 weeks): integration + baseline metrics (tokens, latencies).
   - Phase 2 (4 weeks): controlled batching & cache tuning on reconciliation route only; mirror chat in read-only mode for monitoring.
   - Phase 3: readout + decision (scale vs. stop).
3) Telemetry checklist for ops call (short):
   - token_count_by_route, p50/p95/p99 latency, cache_hit_rate, batch_size_distribution, error_rate, kv_cache_miss_samples (links to logs).

Related links: HubSpot deal & pilot template included below so your procurement and legal teams have something to attach.

I started a draft SOW and will push a cleaner PDF by EOD. If we keep to the $35k cap, we'll propose a focused scope (reconciliation only) to preserve runway and show unit-econ gains before expanding.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2873492/TP-2027-0421
Pilot docs: https://app.redwood.ai/docs/pilot-guides/token-econ-template

Marissa Cole | Senior Sales Manager

Let's lock Tue 18th at 10:00am PT for the 30m ops sync — invite incoming. I'll push the $35k/month target in my internal packet and flag any procurement gating items if they show up.

Appreciate the fast turn here.

-Samir
